res-001.title: Payment gateway timeout & checkout crash
res-001.description: Stripe/Apple Pay webhook timeout during peak checkout hours on v2.3 release causing 504 errors.
res-001.fix_description: Increasing gateway socket timeout to 15s and adding idempotency retry tokens.
res-001.notes: Spike detected via Zendesk and Discord error channels.

res-002.title: SMS verification 6-digit code delay on Android
res-002.description: Twilio SMS carrier latency in APAC region causes user onboarding session timeouts before token arrives.
res-002.fix_description: Added multi-carrier fallback (MessageBird/Vonage) and extended token validity window to 15 minutes.
res-002.notes: 9 out of 10 free-tier dropoffs occur at this step.

res-003.title: Dynamic Type font scaling support on iOS
res-003.description: App ignored system enlarged accessibility fonts, leaving text at fixed 11pt.
res-003.fix_description: Adopted UIFontMetrics and scalable auto-layout constraints across all core dashboard views.

res-004.title: CSV / Excel / PDF data export integration
res-004.description: Enterprise customers require automated weekly data export to CSV and JSON formats.
res-004.fix_description: Implemented background worker for asynchronous CSV/JSON export with signed S3 download URLs.
res-004.notes: NPS score for enterprise segment rose +18 points following release.

res-005.title: Biometric FaceID authentication mismatch on iOS 18
res-005.description: Keychain access group misconfiguration prevents biometric key invalidation on app upgrade.
res-005.notes: Reported in Discord community beta channel.
